About this Event

BOLLYWEEN PARTY 🎃🔥DC — THIS HALLOWEEN, BOLLYWOOD IS TAKING OVER.
Brewing Beats Entertainments & Vibe Districts present BOLLYWEEN PARTY — a massive Bollywood Halloween night taking over Public Bar Live, Washington, DC.
Halloween energy meets Bollywood After Dark. Expect a packed dance floor, crazy costumes, nonstop music, and one unforgettable night in the heart of DC.
This isn’t your regular Halloween party.
This is BOLLYWEEN.

🎃 WHAT TO EXPECT🔥 Bollywood After Dark vibes
🔥 Halloween-themed nightlife experience
🔥 Bollywood • Punjabi • Tollywood • Commercial Hits
🔥 High-energy dance floor
🔥 Costumes & Halloween looks
🔥 Full bar & late-night party
🔥 One of DC’s biggest Desi Halloween nights

🎧 MUSIC BYTWO SISTERZZ
Opening Set by DJ_RONI
From Bollywood bangers and Punjabi anthems to Tollywood, commercial hits, and late-night club music — we’re keeping the dance floor moving all night.
